story.heading: A salon that fits into the trip
paragraphs: Pro-Nails Nailery has been part of Willow Grove Park Mall for years, the salon people find between stores and come back to on purpose.
Professional work, a menu that covers hands, feet, and waxing, and hours that match the mall.

experience.heading: How a visit goes
items: Walk in from the concourse or call ahead to hold a chair.
Pick the service and the color, then settle in.
Pay by card and walk back out to the shopping trip.

feature.heading: Pedicures with the soak built in
feature.text: A proper soak, careful cuticle work, and polish that is dry before you reach the parking garage.
